# kion_custom_variable_override (Data Source)

Use this data source to access information about Kion Custom Variable Overrides. It enumerates overrides across all OUs, projects, and accounts and returns those matching the supplied filter blocks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_custom_variable_override" "example" {
  # filter {
  #   name   = "example"
  #   regex  = false
  #   values = []
  # }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block List) Filter results by attribute. Multiple filter blocks are AND'd; values within a single filter are OR'd. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `list` (Attributes List) This is where Kion makes the discovered data available as a list of resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--list))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name whose values you wish to filter by. Supports dotted paths (e.g. "owner.id") to traverse nested objects.
- `values` (List of String) The values of the field name you specified. A row matches if its field equals any of these values.

Optional:

- `regex` (Boolean) When true, the values are treated as regular expressions instead of exact matches.


<a id="nestedatt--list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `list`

Read-Only:

- `custom_variable_id` (String)
- `entity_id` (String)
- `entity_type` (String)
- `value_list` (List of String)
- `value_map` (Map of String)
- `value_string` (String)
